title: Dr. G as a consortium of anti-submarine scientists, identified by the Ramseys

tellings.quote: Scott and Suzanne Ramsay have really they deserve all the credit for digging up this like kind of like short list of like eight to nine scientists that likely are being represented in this pseudonym Dr. G.

plain: The mysterious "Dr. G" in Behind the Flying Saucers, a 1950 book by the journalist Frank Scully about a saucer said to have crashed near Aztec, New Mexico, was probably not one man but a cover name for a group of scientists who worked against submarines in the war. That is the view of a researcher who posts as UAPGerb, and he gives all the credit to the researchers Scott and Suzanne Ramsey. He says they dug up a short list of eight or nine scientists, a circle that touches the wartime science chief Vannevar Bush, who were likely being represented by the one pseudonym.
